# Development instructions

## Index

- [instruction.instructions.md](./instruction.instructions.md): routing rules for deciding whether content belongs in `instructions`, `skills`, `docs`, or `prompts`.
- [browser-testing.instructions.md](./browser-testing.instructions.md): how to inspect pages with `playwright-core`; temporary scripts in `tmp/` must be deleted afterwards, reusable ones go to skills.
- [documentation-style.instructions.md](./documentation-style.instructions.md): public English docs only, verify against current code, no internal material or images by default.
- [llms-output.instructions.md](./llms-output.instructions.md): how `llms.txt`, per-page `.md` copies, and the skills zip are generated, and where to change them.
